title: City of Torment
author: Bruce R. Cordell
note: conf=0.97; Ebook ISBN 9780786956142 matches the Wizards of the Coast digital edition of City of Torment (print ISBN 9780786951840). It is Book II of the Abolethic Sovereignty trilogy (Plague of Spells, City of Torment, Key of Stars), set in the wider Forgotten Realms shared universe — the tight sub-series is Abolethic Sovereignty.
